resources.string: WebBlock reads the address bar of your browsers to block the websites on your block list. No data is stored or sent anywhere.
You decided you don\'t want to be here right now. Good call.
WebBlock needs the accessibility service to block sites.
Nothing is being blocked right now. To pause again later, tap the green status.
Add websites or apps – blocked always, or only at the times in the schedule.
One per line or separated by commas\ne.g. x.com, youtube.com
Blocked around the clock. In Alpha mode nothing here can be removed or moved.
Blocked at the times set in the schedule. Can always be changed, even in Alpha mode.
When the On schedule list is blocked. The Always list is always blocked.

Until the time you choose, you can\'t remove or move anything on the Always list, turn blocking off, or turn off or uninstall WebBlock in the settings. Changing the date or time doesn\'t end it early. You can always extend it, add new entries and change the On schedule list and the schedule.
Alpha mode is active – WebBlock can\'t be turned off or uninstalled until it ends.
Alpha mode is activated – changes are possible once it ends.
Android 13 and newer: Settings › Apps › WebBlock › ⋮ › \"Allow restricted settings\", then enable it here.
Blocks ads and trackers in all apps and browsers by filtering the addresses they look up. Video ads on YouTube can\'t be blocked this way.

Uses Android\'s VPN slot, but nothing leaves your phone through it. Only one VPN can run at a time: if you start another one (e.g. NordVPN), the ad blocker turns off and a notification lets you turn it back on. Not affected by Alpha mode.
